Or the manager kills this with a stated reason (e.g. the D3/D8 sequence lever is judged not worth the build).

what: Kaggle GPU has no diagnosis-backed ML work (measured 2026-11-17 by lane ML-ITERATION-REFILL-2-20261117). The GPU backend can only run ml_bakeoff learners over the published metis-market-data shards, and every GPU-shaped family is closed or blocked there. (1) Sequence/GRU on D2 regime is CLOSED at power: c21d-05 GRU is worse than lgbm_yz by 0.018 / 0.025 / ~0.02 nats on BTC / ETH / SOL 1h, CI excluding 0 (torch_devices cuda). (2) Tabular foundation models on D2 read as a TIE at full n: ff8f-02 TabICL vs LightGBM gave deltas of about 1e-4. On Kaggle, tabicl/tabpfn arms have only ever reported unavailable (65cc-06/-07/-08): the kernel has no internet for weights, and row ML-NONGBDT-RUNNERS is landed_unproven. (3) The diagnosed D3/D8 questions, entry (Foxhound; c21d-02 gross +0.082 R vs net -0.058 R on the held-out year, so cost-dominated) and the exit head, need the ENTRY decision panel and the exit-path corpus as published Kaggle datasets. Today ml_entry_population_test.py fetches bars live on the runner, so no GPU unit can read them.
why_it_matters: The operator wants every backend to hold meaningful work through the reset. Without a published decision panel, Kaggle GPU can only be filled with floor-filler, which STOP-GENERATED-AUTHORING bans. The build that unlocks diagnosed GPU work is: publish the frozen ml_decision_entry_v1 decision/feature panel (and the corpus_v2 exit paths) to a Kaggle dataset, plus an ml_bakeoff group spec for them. The lane is the manager's to dispatch (Tier 1).
